item.text:
The strongest candidate to reconsider is **CSV ledger export**. The laptop snapshot contains a working-shaped serializer and a sample check, while the current snapshot has no visible export implementation. The archive says the work was deferred, but also says a separate service repository was omitted, so the export’s broader status remains unknown.

- **Potentially useful — CSV export.** [rollupCsv.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/laptop/src/reports/rollupCsv.ts) produces a header and quoted date, label, and amount cells, escaping embedded quotes. [pilot.md](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/laptop/notes/pilot.md) says volunteers wanted spreadsheet downloads during an internal preview; the [screenshot](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/laptop/screenshots/pilot-ledger.png) depicts an Export CSV button, but neither establishes a release. The current [toolbar](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/current/src/ui/toolbar.ts) lists Add record and Search, and [records.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/current/src/routes/records.ts) exposes titles only. Integration therefore needs a verified source for dates and amounts. The [report plan](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/archive/issues/report-plan.md) records deferral and an omitted service repository.

  The later-named [rollupCsvV2.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/archive/src/reports/rollupCsvV2.ts) joins cells without quoting, so labels containing commas would split into extra cells. A [historical failure log](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/archive/logs/report-check.log) reports that problem for an intermediate prototype, but does not identify that file as its source. The laptop serializer addresses comma quoting, yet its [sample check](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/laptop/tests/rollupCsv.test.ts) covers only one comma case. Spreadsheet formula handling remains an explicit unresolved concern in the pilot note.

- **Equivalent behavior present — title filtering.** [filterBox.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/laptop/src/ui/filterBox.ts) and current [queryIndex.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/current/src/search/queryIndex.ts) both trim and lowercase the query, then perform a case-insensitive title substring match. [RecordFinder.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/current/src/ui/RecordFinder.ts) calls the current implementation, consistent with the [migration note](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/current/docs/search-migration.md). There is no apparent need to restore the old function within this snapshot.

- **Intentionally retired — remember-browser prototype.** [rememberBrowser.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/laptop/src/auth/rememberBrowser.ts) stores a supplied session token in browser localStorage. The [session review](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/archive/issues/session-review.md) records a decision to remove it and use server-issued HTTP-only cookies; [operations.md](/tmp/ghost-local-muhwbpyr/current/docs/operations.md) describes that approach while placing deployment configuration outside the archive. Do not restore the prototype without a fresh security review. These notes do not establish the deployed system’s actual security properties.

**Coding-agent handoff:** First locate the omitted report service and confirm whether an export already exists and where authorized report data comes from. If still needed, integrate a CSV download into the current UI using an agreed data contract; use the laptop serializer as a reference, not the unquoted V2 prototype. Resolve spreadsheet formula-injection handling before release, including dangerous leading characters and any intended spreadsheet compatibility. Add and run tests for commas, quotes, embedded newlines, empty data, numeric values, formula-like labels, and the download flow. Verify access control and the exported fields against the actual application.

I inventoried all three authorized folders and read the relevant source, notes, and logs. The snapshots are explicitly incomplete; the separate service repository and deployment configuration were unavailable. I did not execute source or tests, use Git, or access external services. Historical logs are reported as records, not independently verified results.
